app_title: ClearSpace — Disk Space Analyzer & Safe Cleaner for Windows
subtitle: Intelligent disk analysis, full-verified duplicate detection, and safe Recycle Bin cleanup.
dash_subtitle: Available drives, latest scan summary, and potentially recoverable disk space.
search_placeholder: Search by file name, path, or category...
cleanup_subtitle: ClearSpace never deletes files automatically or permanently: selected items are verified and moved to the Windows Recycle Bin.
cleanup_safe_count: Safe items (Temp / Duplicate copies / Empty folders)
cleanup_candidate_count: User candidates to review (Large / Old / Downloads)
cleanup_disclaimer: Note: Actual recovered space may be lower if some files are locked by Windows or in use by running applications. All items are sent to the Windows Recycle Bin.
cleanup_confirm_check: I have reviewed the preview of selected files and confirm moving them to the Windows Recycle Bin.
cleanup_empty_hint: No items selected. Select files from the Analysis, Duplicates, or Large Files pages first.
history_subtitle: Log of completed scans with throughput metrics and identified space.
settings_subtitle: Customize theme, language, default thresholds, protected/excluded directories, and SQLite cache.
settings_use_cache: Enable per-drive SQLite cache (reuse index and results)
status_ready_bar: Ready. Select drives and analysis modes.
status_Select_drive: Please select at least one drive to scan.
status_select_mode: Please select at least one analysis mode.
status_param_changed_scanning: Parameters updated: re-filter will apply automatically or via 'Reapply filters'.
warn_Select_items: Please select at least one item from the table.
params_changed_hint: Thresholds or modes differ from the displayed results. Use 'Reapply filters' (fast, uses the index) or start a new analysis.
cleanup_warn_full_group: Warning: ALL copies are selected in {count} duplicate groups. No copy will remain on disk.
status_cleanup_running: Moving {count} items to the Recycle Bin...
settings_exclusions_hint: System folders (Windows, Program Files, $Recycle.Bin, System Volume Information, ...) are always protected. Folders added here are excluded from both scanning and cleanup.
privacy_hint: The file index, history and logs stay on this PC only (%LOCALAPPDATA%\ClearSpace), readable by your Windows account. ClearSpace never sends anything over the network. The red button deletes the index, cached results, history and logs; it does not touch your personal files or the Recycle Bin.
privacy_wipe_confirm: The scanned-file index, cached results, history and logs will be deleted. Language, theme and thresholds are kept. Files on disk and in the Recycle Bin are not touched.
dup_remove_confirm:
Move {count} duplicate copies ({size}) from {groups} groups to the Recycle Bin?

The original of each group (marked 'Original') is kept. Every file is re-checked before it is moved, and you can restore it from the Windows Recycle Bin.
dup_remove_none: There are no duplicate copies to remove.
page_sub_duplicates: Progressive verification (size → partial hash → full BLAKE2b hash). The original in each group is never auto-selected.
page_sub_large_files: Files above the configured size threshold, ranked by disk usage.
page_sub_temp: Only temp and cache files recognized by reliable rules (.tmp, ~$, partial downloads, browser caches, temp logs...).
page_sub_old_files: Files whose last modification is older than the given number of days.
page_sub_empty_dirs: Only folders that are truly empty (no files, not even hidden ones) and readable.
page_sub_old_downloads: Files in Downloads folders older than the given number of days.
cat_hint: Press Analyze to search only this category. Other results stay as they are.
